Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc increased its stake in Xcel Energy Inc (XEL) by 7.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc bought 24,067 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 350,457 shares of the power generation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.86M, up from 326,390 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc who had been investing in Xcel Energy Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.00B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.46% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $45.27. About 789,139 shares traded. Xcel Energy Inc. (NYSE:XEL) has risen 0.76% since April 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.79% the S&P500. 
Hoertkorn Richard Charles decreased its stake in Bank Of America Corporation (BAC) by 4.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hoertkorn Richard Charles sold 18,675 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 387,801 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.45 million, down from 406,476 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hoertkorn Richard Charles who had been investing in Bank Of America Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $298.44 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.67% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $29.19. About 26.56 million shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 28.18% since April 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.63% the S&P500. 
Hoertkorn Richard Charles, which manages about $139.37M and $168.64 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE:BABA) by 5,195 shares to 14,855 shares, valued at $2.56 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apache Corp (NYSE:APA) by 19,430 shares in the quarter, for a total of 79,940 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
